title: Horned Figure with Rings
description: A horned, robed figure with a beetle-covered chest stands in the foreground holding up several glowing golden rings. In the background, hooded figures sit in a ritual circle surrounded by lit candles and incense against a dark, ink-splattered backdrop with floating symbols and insects.
prompt: A large horned figure wearing a dark robe and ornate mask stands prominently in the foreground, its chest covered in detailed beetle illustrations. The figure holds several glowing golden rings aloft in one hand. Behind it, several hooded figures sit in a circular formation around lit candles and burning incense sticks. The background features black ink splatters, floating abstract symbols, insects, and glowing orbs on a muted gray surface, creating an occult ritual atmosphere.
